sources.title: Contraception and Birth Control Methods
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; August 6, 2024
sources.sections: Opening informed-choice considerations and infection-prevention distinction
sources.supported_use: Separate pregnancy prevention from infection prevention; preserve voluntary informed choice.
sources.limits: General distinctions only; no individual method selection, effectiveness rate, dose, medical-history assessment or treatment change.

sources.title: Infertility: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; May 15, 2024
sources.sections: Definition and individual-care caveat; assessment, reproductive-partner and aging discussions
sources.supported_use: Use population information to formulate individualized qualified-care questions.
sources.limits: The public-health definition is explicitly not individual-care guidance. No exact age/duration referral rule, fertility prediction, diagnosis or testing algorithm is imported.

sources.title: Antenatal (pregnancy) care and appointments
sources.author: NHS; reviewed April 17, 2026
sources.sections: Opening account of professional care, individual needs/preferences and contacting care about concerns
sources.supported_use: Distinguish pregnancy care from preparation and support accessible person-specific discussion.
sources.limits: NHS system context only; no appointment schedule, screening regimen or test recommendation transferred to another system or person.

sources.title: Urgent Maternal Warning Signs and Symptoms
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; May 15, 2024
sources.sections: Opening prompt-care guidance and physical/mental warning-sign sections
sources.supported_use: Actual concerning pregnancy/postpartum symptoms require prompt appropriate help, not completion of a support worksheet.
sources.limits: Nonexhaustive resource, not a triage instrument, diagnostic gate or certification that absence of a listed symptom establishes safety. No false calls or induced symptoms.

sources.title: Miscarriage
sources.author: NHS; reviewed March 31, 2026
sources.sections: What happens afterward, emotional support, counselling and partner support
sources.supported_use: Make room for different experiences and appropriately offered support.
sources.limits: Only support sections used; no treatment instructions, thresholds, fertility predictions or universal account of infertility/reproductive grief.

sources.title: Adoption
sources.author: Child Welfare Information Gateway / Children’s Bureau
sources.sections: Introductory legal, social and emotional dimensions; loss, identity, family and cultural connections
sources.supported_use: Belonging can preserve origins and perspectives without assuming legal powers.
sources.limits: Overview, not a placement/contact decision, attachment diagnosis or validation of the shelf exercise. Adoption guidance does not make foster, step and chosen-family authority identical.

sources.title: Child Abuse Education Resources
sources.author: Arizona Department of Education
sources.type: primary state-agency educational and routing page
sources.sections: Prompt reporting, Arizona Child Abuse Hotline 1-888-767-2445 and 911 for immediate danger
sources.supported_use: Identify an official receiving contact for the bounded Arizona caregiving example and separate it from an education website.
sources.limits: Arizona example only; this education page is not itself a report. Role, circumstances, tribal routes and required methods need applicable official verification. Direct DCS page body was blocked and is not claimed inspected.

sources.title: Arizona Revised Statutes §13-3620
sources.author: Arizona Legislature
sources.sections: Subsections A, D, F, G, H and J: roles, immediacy, known information, destination distinctions and specified exceptions
sources.supported_use: Check actual role/circumstance-dependent reporting obligations; internal discussion cannot replace a required external report.
sources.limits: Illustrative Arizona school-personnel case outside an Indian reservation with an alleged adult having care/custody/control. Not a comprehensive legal interpretation or certification; the statute treats some other circumstances differently. No universal mandate to use one destination for every case.

sources.title: What to do if a child reveals abuse
sources.author: NSPCC
sources.sections: Listening, taking concerns seriously, no blame, explaining next steps and not confronting the alleged person
sources.supported_use: Respond calmly without secrecy promises, amateur credibility tests or confrontation.
sources.limits: United Kingdom contact routes are not transferred to Arizona or other jurisdictions. Support guidance is not a receiving agency, local reporting law, investigation or safety guarantee.

sources.title: Calling 911
sources.author: National 911 Program; updated January 24, 2023
sources.sections: Emergency police/fire/ambulance route and warning that the website cannot provide emergency assistance
sources.supported_use: Distinguish emergency contact from visiting an information website.
sources.limits: United States context only; no practice calls, promised response time or automatic applicability elsewhere.

sources.title: Effective Discipline to Raise Healthy Children
sources.author: Robert D. Sege, Benjamin S. Siegel and AAP committees (2018); correction 2019
sources.sections: Abstract, opening teaching rationale and recommendations; linked 2019 correction separately inspected
sources.supported_use: Use developmentally appropriate constructive teaching without physical punishment or shaming.
sources.limits: Policy guidance, not empirical validation of either original book exercise, individual developmental assessment or a complete media/worldview curriculum. The inspected correction adds liaison credit and does not alter the teaching recommendation used.

sources.title: Supported Decision Making Program
sources.author: Administration for Community Living; modified July 17, 2023
sources.sections: Opening account of person-chosen supports tailored to types of decisions while retaining control
sources.supported_use: Preserve accessible participation and chosen task-specific assistance.
sources.limits: No clinical capacity determination, guardianship appointment or grant of legal power. Actual local authority and qualified guidance remain necessary.

sources.title: Lasting power of attorney for people with dementia
sources.author: Alzheimer’s Society
sources.sections: Advance planning, participation and different property/finance versus health/welfare powers; jurisdiction distinctions
sources.supported_use: Identify legal-planning questions separately from everyday support or a diagnosis.
sources.limits: England and Wales LPA context; Northern Ireland is distinguished separately. No form, fee, power or rule is transferred to another jurisdiction, and no family vote establishes authority.

sources.title: The Cognitive Dimension of Household Labor
sources.author: Allison Daminger (2019)
sources.type: primary empirical paper, publisher abstract inspected
sources.sections: Abstract describing cognitive labor in interviews with 70 people in 35 couples
sources.supported_use: Make anticipating, planning and monitoring visible alongside execution.
sources.limits: Abstract-only use, inspected earlier on the same date for the preceding batch; this batch’s attempted refresh failed. No uninspected methods, universal fairness metric, gender prescription or validation of the multigeneration meal case.

sources.title: Communicating with your child’s other parent during separation
sources.author: Cafcass
sources.sections: Practical communication and avoiding the child-as-messenger role
sources.supported_use: Keep adult logistical communication and disputes out of the dependent person’s responsibility.
sources.limits: England family-justice context; not universal contact rights or a custody order. Ordinary cooperation recommendations do not require direct contact or mediation when unsafe/prohibited.

sources.title: Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage
sources.author: UNESCO (2003)
sources.sections: Introduction and Article 2 definitions, living recreation, transmission and human-rights compatibility
sources.supported_use: Heritage can be transmitted and revised while respecting participants.
sources.limits: Conceptual use, not a household legal mandate, authenticity score or evidence that this activity improves belonging. No compulsory ritual or belief.

sources.title: Cultural Documentation Guidelines
sources.author: Library of Congress, American Folklife Center; page dated September 26, 2018
sources.sections: Respectful listening and obtaining participant permissions on the landing page
sources.supported_use: Separate willingness to tell from permission to record or publish.
sources.limits: Landing page only; linked release forms, training PDFs and intellectual-property rules were not reviewed or adopted. No blanket archival consent follows from a family story.

sources.title: Healthy Habits: Caring for Yourself When Caring for Another
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; September 3, 2024
sources.sections: Specific help requests, caregiver support and respite through people or services
sources.supported_use: Make relief needs specific and explore accepted appropriate coverage.
sources.limits: No guaranteed availability, funding, competence, quantified health effect or cure for burnout. Handoff arithmetic and the fictional interval are original design.
